reasons: Both answers meet all three rubric items: each says plainly to send now because the slot is in 25 minutes and the preparation is for an interview that will not happen, neither hints at waiting, and both code blocks carry a complete Russian message naming Karina's withdrawal and the cancelled slot without inventing a reason or a new hiring plan. B fits the request more exactly — the message plus a two-clause rationale, tightly written — while A surrounds the message with three paragraphs of unrequested coaching (how to keep the do-not-disturb rule credible, when to ask Karina for her reason), of which only the "call if no reaction" note adds real operational value. On the secondary standard of fit and clarity B edges ahead; on the rubric itself they are equal, so the margin is small.
